purpose: Persistent state for incremental discovery and deep-audit cost control. Source fingerprints live in source_inventory.json; this file tracks audit scheduling and unresolved work.

rules.unchanged_master: Do not reread every protocol solely because the master page is unchanged; verify changed, stale, unresolved, or due-for-forced-reread items.
rules.unresolved: Retry only when recheck_after is due or source fingerprint changes.
